theorem _root_.CompressionEval.fresh_number_theory_07 (a b d : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime a b) (ha : d ∣ a) (hb : d ∣ b) :
  d = 1 ∧ d ∣ a + b :=
by
  have hd : d ∣ 1 := by
    simpa [h.gcd_eq_one] using Nat.dvd_gcd ha hb
  have he := Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one hd
  subst d
  simp
